leads.Personalized Subject Line: The Girl from Oto: a trailer idea
leads.Personalized Email Body:
Hi Amy,

My name is Femi Emmanuel. I'm a designer and book services specialist, helping authors professionally present, publish, and promote their books.

I came across The Girl from Oto and Mira's Way while researching your work. I was particularly interested in a Renaissance-era woman artist and the modern scholar on her trail, and in history's silenced stories.

Those details gave me an idea for how a short book trailer could help present your books to more of the readers who may enjoy them. A trailer could move between a Renaissance painting and a modern archive, following the scholar's search.

I'd be happy to put together a complimentary concept sample so you can see the direction I have in mind.

Would you be open to taking a look?

Warm regards,
Femi Emmanuel
